entries.publisher: Qi, Tang, Zhang, Wang & Qian (Scientific Data 13, 277, 2026), via Figshare
entries.published_license_notes: Figshare API (api.figshare.com/v2/articles/30015124, checked 2026-11-09) lists the item licence as CC0 (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0). The article itself (doi:10.1038/s41597-026-06605-9) is CC BY 4.0. Cite the paper. Not human-reviewed.
confirmed_facts: Archive contains exactly two workbooks: Chinese_Climate_Finance_2000-2021.xlsx and Chinese_Development_Finance_SDG_Categorizations_2000-2021.xlsx

Both workbooks are byte-identical to Figshare item 30015124 version 1 (MD5 7fd6e1d1459c1aac2fe32694010053cf and 488f213db78985973051e81e7fd639b9 match the Figshare API, checked 2026-11-09); Figshare published date 2026-02-20
Every AidData_Record_ID in both workbooks exists in AidData GCDF 3.0
rio_marker order is (Overall, Mitigation, Adaptation) per the paper's Table 1 header; scores 0/1/2 = not targeted/significant/principal per Methods, Data processing
Research workbook text fields are truncated at 255 characters (Title 12 rows, Funding_Agencies 7, Funding_Agencies_Type 1) relative to AidData
assumptions: Acquisition date not recorded by the developer (file timestamps are not evidence of download date)
The local ZIP wrapper (30015124.zip) bundles the Figshare files at download time; its own bytes are not published by Figshare
limitations: The paper states inter-annotator agreement statistics are included in the final dataset, but no agreement column exists in either workbook
Labels are the authors' annotations, cross-verified with ClimateBERT per the paper; they are not independent ground truth
